overrides.description: Plain melee test: advances directly and attacks once in range.
Ranged kiter test: keeps room distance, finds line of sight, then fires.
Swarm test: multiple swarm units should cluster around the same target.

Swarm test: multiple swarm units should cluster around the same target.
Charger test: prefers a distant target and dashes/charges in directly.
Skirmisher test: favors wounded or weak targets and tries to avoid opportunity attacks.
Guardian test: presses nearest intruders while a ranged ally stands behind it.
Brute test: lumbers in, ignores finesse, and favors soft or weak targets.
Artillery test: seeks a firing angle, prefers vulnerable targets, and has a melee screen.
Controller test: seeks control angles and has a frontline ally to make the room less empty.

intro.text: A practical monster AI behavior lab. Open one side room at a time from the Observation Hall. Each room is labeled for the behavior it is meant to exercise: melee, ranged kiter, swarm, charger, skirmisher, guardian, brute, artillery, and controller.
